subject.title: fix(control-ui): resolve Personal card avatar 401 via data URI

question: Which avatar-401 branch should become the canonical landing path for the Personal-card workspace-avatar bug, and should the data-URI/fallback behavior in this narrow PR be accepted?
rationale: Automation can identify the type/lint blockers, but choosing between this conflicting narrow PR, the proof-positive broader PR, and the UI-only overlap requires maintainer coordination of compatibility and owner-boundary tradeoffs.

options.title: Use the broader avatar PR after repair
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 once its SDK-surface blocker is fixed because it covers identity, list, bootstrap, and UI projection with stronger proof.

options.title: Repair this narrow PR

options.title: Split backend and UI fixes
